text: Men will turn 30 and still be like, I don't know what I want. Bro, we have five more years with hair. Please figure it out. Right, this is not time to be spiritually wandering through life, finding ourselves. We're not 22 anymore. So no, you can't just see where it goes anymore. Where it goes is bald, broken, alone, if we don't start making some decisions around here. Okay, here's what I wanna say. For a lot of men, life doesn't even start until 30. Why? Because most guys spend their teens and 20s at a huge disadvantage. You don't have resources, you don't have status, you don't have experience. There's even a saying that goes something like this. There's nothing more precious than a young woman and nothing more useless than a young man. And while it sounds harsh, it partly captures the reality. Young men usually don't bring much to the table yet. But here's the good news. Men age differently. It takes years, sometimes decades, to build yourself. Your career, your body, your confidence, your social skills. And once you do, you actually become more interesting, more attractive, and more valuable. That's why so many guys hit their stride in their 30s and 40s. So don't let anyone tell you that turning 30 is the end. It's the beginning. Even if you're 40 or 50, you can still change your life, build yourself up, and live on your own terms. And by the way, if you're balding, big deal. Get a hair transplant or just shave it clean.
